title: record_failure re-reads attempt_count from DB when entry already has it
description: OutboxStore::record_failure issues a SELECT attempt_count FROM outbox to re-read the count, despite receiving a fully-populated OutboxEntry that already carries attempt_count. The redundant read is then discarded — entry.attempt_count is never consulted. The extra query adds noise and could mislead a future reader into thinking entry.attempt_count is unreliable.
